column1: # Title: China annual CO2 emissions by sector - Carbon Monitor reference data
# Description: Reference values derived from Carbon Monitor near-real-time data.
#   Used for validating GCAM-China emission scenarios against observed trends.
#   Power = electricity and heat; Industry = industrial combustion;
#   Ground Transport = road transport; Residential = buildings/heating;
#   Domestic Aviation + International Aviation = civil aviation.
